name: content_hash
description: SHA-256 of the source PDF; joins to announcements.content_hash and parsed_documents.content_hash.

name: model
description: Model identifier that produced the extraction, e.g. claude-opus-4-8. One eval run = filter by (model, prompt_version).

name: prompt_version
description: Versioned prompt artifact, e.g. earnings_v1 (prompts/earnings_v1.md). (content_hash, model, prompt_version) is unique; new versions append, never overwrite.

name: payload
description: JSON-serialized EarningsResult (per-field value + confidence + verbatim source quote + page). STRING rather than JSON type: the eval harness validates payloads back through the Pydantic schema, so BQ only needs to store the bytes; query ad hoc with PARSE_JSON.
